description: Search or browse maintained sources with coverage, last-read time, row count, count-check method, and current status. When query matches nothing, next says what to do: ask_for_it (request_source with the same words), open_pot (the open bounty for the same words, with its pledge_url) when one exists, and post_bounty (bounty_post).

query.description: Free text, e.g. 'hospital leadership' or 'county bids'.

title: List maintained public sources
